# Fixtures

Real responses captured from `extranet-lv.bwfbadminton.com/api` on 2026-09-21.

- `popular_*.json` — `vue-popular-players` (search) responses (`popular_chong_wei.json` is the response for the phrase "chong wei", used to find the retired Lee Chong Wei, who is not in the index). The bulky `pagination.data` duplicate of `results` was removed.
- `h2h_players_index.json` — `vue-h2h-players`, trimmed from 3,429 entries to a deterministic sample (plus a few required names, including Aadhya SHINE). The real index does not include every player (e.g. Kento MOMOTA is absent).
- `summary_*.json` — `vue-player-summary` (R2 source: `country_model`, `bio_model.height`, `bio_model.plays`). `summary_no_details.json` is a real player (Aadhya SHINE, id 89438) whose nationality, height and hand are all unset; `summary_unknown_player.json` is the response for a non-existent id (`results` is empty).
- `tournaments_*.json` — `vue-player-tournaments` (R4), one file per player and calendar year: Jonatan CHRISTIE (73442; 2025 with 18 tournaments incl. the Sudirman Cup team event, 2026 with 12 incl. the Thomas & Uber Cup) and Aadhya SHINE (89438; 2025 and 2026, including a tournament with two events, women's singles and doubles). Trimmed: the site's per-tournament `tournament_model` (about 250 fields plus logos and contact details) was reduced to the fields the parser reads (id, name, slug, dates, `type_id`, category/series ids, country name and ISO code); `draws` are complete and unchanged.
- `calendar_page1..4.json` — `vue-tournaments-search` for 2025-09-21..2026-09-21 (100 per page, 326 tournaments, 4 pages). Trimmed to `id`, `name`, dates, `location`, `country` and `category`. 62 of the 326 rows have no `category` key at all, exactly as the site sends them.
- `ranking_*.json` — `vue-player-ranking-events` / `-current` / `-history` (R3). Players: Jonatan CHRISTIE (73442, ranked #1, men's singles), Aadhya SHINE (89438, two events: women's singles and women's doubles), Zygimantas MOLIS (39881, a single history row), Lee Chong Wei (50152, retired: `current` is `"-"`, history ends in 2019). `ranking_events_none.json` is the response for a non-existent id (an empty list). Note `results` of `-history` is a JSON string, exactly as the site sends it.
